en: You found them all! Your eye for art is keen. I am Brassius, Artazon's gym leader, and an artist of the grass.
A battle is a sculpture made in a moment. Let us shape something magnificent together!
Bravo! A masterpiece of a battle. Take this, the Grass Badge, as a frame for your triumph.
{player} received the Grass Badge from Brassius!
Go forth and find your art, young challenger. Victory Road has much more to show you.
Ah, a challenger! But my Sunflora are still hiding about Artazon. Find all three, and then we shall make art.
A challenger who is not yet a student? Enrol at the academy first, and then we shall make art.
Your battle still inspires me. I have begun a new sculpture in its honour.
